items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...He used to play tennis sax with Joe Venuti. [INTERVIEWEE] Who was that?

ctx.x: No, before that. Must have been before that. Yeah, I'm sure it would.
And it's hard to find now. Yeah. I know the head of that company, I guess. He's a friend of mine. He used to play tennis sax with Joe Venuti.
